craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Tamed-held; staff-revealed to-us. Rejected: (a) to-us→for-us → killed: to-us is shown-to. Read aloud: WORLD en-TIRE … TO-us.

lines: World entire by my power tamed, all stations held —
so staff-held revealed: Consciousness-Bhairava, to us.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jagad akhilaṃ macchaktyā damitaṃ sarvavyāvasthitīr dhatte iti daṇḍadhāraṇavaśād vyanakṣi cidbhairavāsmākam

reads_against.argmap: What does my power subdue? → Subdued all held; staff-revealed to us.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
